depends_on.name: element_id
depends_on.documentation: Vintage A only: the element/subject this image depicts. Absent on current NDI production documents.

depends_on.name: ontology_table_row_id
depends_on.documentation: Vintage B only: the metadata table row giving this image its data context. NOT a subject -- resolving the subject through it is the NDI second pass's job, which is why vintage B is deferred rather than migrated here.

fields.name: ontology_nodes
fields.documentation: Vintage B (current NDI production): one or more ontology CURIEs for what the image depicts, comma-joined and sorted, each normalised through ndi.ontology.lookup. The v1 template's singular `ontologyNode` is stale; the writer and its own lookup query both use the plural.

fields.name: ontology_name
fields.documentation: Vintage A (legacy): the CURIE of the depicted region.

fields.name: ontology_region
fields.documentation: Vintage A (legacy): the human-readable label of the depicted region.
